Agent Name: Orchestrator

Step Number: 15

Reason for Mistake: The mistake occurred when the Orchestrator concluded that "Becker" is the worst-rated series based on an audience score of 85%, which was incorrectly compared to other series scores. The Orchestrator failed to correctly identify the series with the lowest Rotten Tomatoes rating. The error was due to a misunderstanding or misrepresentation of the ratings data, as "CSI: Crime Scene Investigation" was noted to have an audience score of 80%, which is actually lower than 85%. Therefore, the Orchestrator's reasoning led to an incorrect conclusion about the worst-rated series.
